Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical/mapping error: after correctly finding that Roberto Rossellini (director of The Machine to Kill Bad People) died in 1977 and Giuliano Carnimeo (director of Poker in Bed) died in 2016, they incorrectly concluded that Poker in Bed has the director who died earlier and even misattributed Rossellini to Poker in Bed. This film–director mix-up led to the wrong final answer.
